_comment: ZeRO Stage 2 shards optimizer states and gradients (not parameters) across GPUs. Parameters stay fully replicated on every GPU, so it needs more GPU memory than Stage 3 but has lower communication overhead and is generally faster. Best for models that fit in GPU memory in full precision per-GPU but whose optimizer states do not (roughly up to ~13B-30B depending on GPU count/memory). Stage 3 additionally shards parameters themselves, enabling much larger models (30B+) to train on the same hardware, at the cost of higher communication volume (parameters must be all-gathered on demand) and typically slower throughput.
